title: Berlin COVID-protest camp reported in October
reason: No evidence of an executed public gathering of at least 50; chronology describes a remaining camp of 20 tents and some unoccupied tents.
notes: Possible episode began before October, but the start date is not documented; retain as a continuity gap rather than inventing a start date.

title: Planned anti-COVID classroom action in a Darmstadt school
reason: The school principal refused the proposed action; no gathering is reported as executed.
notes: Planning is not an observed event.

title: Second planned Berlin demonstration against COVID policy
reason: Tagesspiegel reports the separate planned Great Star gathering was cancelled before it took place.
notes: Do not count the cancelled gathering as the earlier Alexanderplatz/Bersarinplatz march.
